name: backendapi
description: Playwright API tests for loanwalk use cases

scripts.test: node scripts/run-env.mjs ENV=stg COUNTRY=usa STORE=23005 -- tests/loanwalk
scripts.test:loanwalk: node scripts/run-env.mjs ENV=stg COUNTRY=usa STORE=23005 -- tests/loanwalk
scripts.test:loanwalk:stg:usa:23005: node scripts/run-env.mjs ENV=stg COUNTRY=usa STORE=23005 -- tests/loanwalk
scripts.test:teams:stg:usa:23005: node scripts/run-env.mjs ENV=stg COUNTRY=usa STORE=23005 TEAMS_NOTIFY=1 -- tests/loanwalk
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/run-env.mjs ENV=stg COUNTRY=usa STORE=23005 -- tests/loanwalk --ui
scripts.test:debug: node scripts/run-env.mjs ENV=stg COUNTRY=usa STORE=23005 -- tests/loanwalk --debug
scripts.report: npx allure generate ./allure-results --clean && npx allure open ./allure-report
